data.gender_notes: Irtifaah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'r-t-f' meaning 'to give'. The name Irtifaah refers to a gift or grace from Allah. The name Irtifaah carries the meaning “Gift, Grace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Irtifaah usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sign of Allah's blessings and favor
data.etymology: Irtifaah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Irtifaah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
